newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch end higher, bund futures pull the market.
newsitem.headline: Dutch end higher, bund futures pull the market.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Dutch bonds end higher despite wavering start, and some buying interest remains in 2005-2010 segment. Bund futures support guilder bonds. Volume lower than moderate, as U.S. closed today. Short-end out of favour. Occasionally some lengthening noted. No impact from Q3 Dutch GDP data earlier. * 6.25 July 1998 up 0.04 at 104.16/24, yielding 3.54 at bid. * Sept 2001 116.61/71, bid yld 4.78 pct, vs 116.44/54, 4.78. * Jan 2006 102.16/24, 5.68 pct bid yield, vs 101.91/99, 5.68. * 10-yr yld spread vs April 2006 steady -7 basis pts. * Jan 2023s +0.35 to 112.69/89, yield 6.47 pct or 18 basis
